newsitem.title: USA: Chevron names new pipeline unit president.
newsitem.headline: Chevron names new pipeline unit president.

text.p: Chevron Corp named Jeet Bindra president of Chevron Pipe Line Co. on Friday, and announced the retirement of Joe Martinelli, effective January 1.

Bindra, 49, was manager of strategic planning and led the company's negotiations in taking a share of the Caspian Pipeline Consortium, a multi-national company which seeks to build a pipeline from western Kazakstan to the Black Sea.
The pipeline deal was completed December 6 and Bindra will continue to oversee Chevron's role in the project, the company said in a statement.
